message.content: {"predictors": [{"name": "Insider Option Exercise Ratio", "construction": "Total value of insider options exercised over the past 12 months divided by total insider shares held, using Form 4 SEC filings.", "rationale": "High insider exercising may indicate perceived overvaluation or liquidity needs, while low exercising could signal undervaluation or confidence in future upside.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Customer Concentration Change", "construction": "Year-over-year change in the percentage of revenue from the largest customer, using segment reporting and 10-K disclosures.", "rationale": "Increasing customer diversification lowers risk of adverse shocks, while rising concentration may signal vulnerability.", "higher_returns_for": "large decreases in customer concentration"}, {"name": "Nonlinear SG&A Efficiency", "construction": "Deviation of SG&A expense growth from a nonlinear (e.g., quadratic) function of revenue growth over the past three years.", "rationale": "Firms that scale SG&A more efficiently than peers may have superior operational leverage or cost control.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with negative deviations (SG&A growing less than predicted from revenue)"}, {"name": "Industry Disruption Exposure", "construction": "Count of patent grants by US-based companies in the firm's primary SIC industry (using USPTO data), normalized by the firm's market cap.", "rationale": "Industries facing technological disruption may see higher competitive pressure; firms with high exposure may be at risk.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with low exposure values"}, {"name": "ESG Momentum", "construction": "Change in annual ESG controversy score (from RepRisk/KLD database) over the past year.", "rationale": "Improvement in ESG profile may reduce risk premia or attract incremental capital.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with large positive changes (improving ESG scores)"}, {"name": "Unrealized Tax Loss Carryforward Growth", "construction": "Year-over-year percentage increase in total deferred tax assets from NOL carryforwards, from 10-K tax footnotes.", "rationale": "Growing tax shields may signal persistent unprofitability or aggressive accounting.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with low or negative growth in this measure"}, {"name": "Supplier Payment Stretch", "construction": "Change in accounts payable days (payables / COGS * 365) over the past year.", "rationale": "Increasing payables days may indicate tightening credit conditions or cash flow stress.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with decreasing or stable accounts payable days"}, {"name": "Employee Productivity Dispersion", "construction": "Standard deviation of sales per employee across business segments, as reported in segment data in 10-K.", "rationale": "High dispersion may indicate inefficient resource allocation or underperforming divisions.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with low productivity dispersion"}, {"name": "R&D Intensity Acceleration", "construction": "Second derivative (acceleration) of R&D expense to sales ratio over the past three years.", "rationale": "Firms ramping up their R&D investment may be preparing for new product launches or innovation-driven growth.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with high positive acceleration"}, {"name": "Shareholder Proposal Resistance", "construction": "Number of shareholder proposals opposed by management and subsequently defeated at annual meetings, trailing three years (using SEC proxy filings).", "rationale": "Management that resists shareholder engagement may entrench themselves, potentially reducing future value creation.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with low resistance counts"}]}
